title: Shore-Power Pedestal Load by Slip
dataSources: Battery telemetry (`marine:battery`), AIS traffic (`marine:ais`), shore power (`marina:power`), tide forecasts (`tide:table`), export syncs (`marine:export`).
app: Boating and marine telemetry — Victron BMV battery exports, AIS transponder logs, shore-power meter readings, and NOAA tide tables — streamed to Splunk HEC via NMEA exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=marina:power slip_id=* load_amps=*
| stats avg(load_amps) as avg_load_amps, count as events by slip_id
| sort - avg_load_amps
description: Shows average load amps by slip for marina electricity use.
value: Average load amps by slip helps compare marina electricity use across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `load_amps` on `marina:power` events and normalize `slip_id` so Splunk can summarize performance by slip.
visualization: Bar chart of average load amps by slip.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals the average load amps for each slip so you can see what works best for marina electricity use.
